ideaDescription: A web tool for small retail teams that automates inventory alerts reducing stockouts and manual spreadsheet work.
technicalSummary: A CSV-first web PoC for threshold inventory alerts is clearly scoped and resource-cheap, but the technical approach is a known pattern with little novelty; success is measurable via stockouts and time-on-spreadsheet.
marketSummary: Stockouts and spreadsheet inventory work are credible pains for small retail, but the description has no willingness-to-pay evidence and weak differentiation versus POS and automation incumbents.
insights: Memory bank: when willingness-to-pay has no price signal or existing spend, rate pay conservatively (≤4) and call out missing evidence — applied to this idea (pay=4).
